Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> Thanks for the plug, Josh.
> Anyone any comments on the site, so far? People using it?

I tried using it after Josh gave me the link. The only thing I found
myself wanting was the ability to enter more than 3 disciplines. Oh,
also the ability to flag whether you wanted the result set to return
vamps that had only those disciplines or vamps that had at least
X of the specified disciplines.
So if I were looking for dom ani pro pot, I could say "ok, give me all
the vamps that have at least 3 of those" and it would return vamps
with "dom ani pot", "ani pro dom", etc. That would make it really
useful in helping pick out filler vamps.

Other than that, I found it pretty useful. :p

Sorrow
